script.text: Stop playing GTA six until you know these crucial mechanics, or you will lose fights needlessly.
I am going through four mistakes I wish someone warned me about before starting out.
Our list goes from basic trunk storage all the way to high damage ocean speargun tactics.
Now that your trunk is packed, tip number two is aiming your weapon at store clerks to start robberies.
Keeping your gun trained on store clerks prevents them from alerting police during robberies.
Tip number three is all about civilian reactions, but the biggest mistake is not subscribing.
Passing close to civilian NPCs outside retail store fronts triggers unique dynamic verbal and physical responses.
Nah, I am kidding - but subscribe anyway, this channel covers everything GTA six.
Approaching NPCs standing near shop windows makes them engage in distinct localized animations.
Finally, tip number four is the most important tactic when confronting tourist NPCs on open water.
Holding a speargun aboard boats unlocks contextual interaction prompts like defuse, provoke, rob, or dismiss.
Firing the speargun at close range aboard boats delivers silent water eliminations.
Knocking targets off vessel railings triggers unique ragdoll physics as they tumble into the water.
